warnings: '(ชั้นล่าง)' names the LOWER of two roof planes (a secondary/porch roof), not a floor level — see S-08 for the main/upper roof covering the full building. This is structural roof framing (marked members, grid refs), so per the op04 roof_plan-vs-plan rule it is extracted as pattern 'plan', not 'roof_plan'.

The printed roof outline (thin reference line) and grid-crossing X marks span the full building depth (1.00m north of A through 1.00m south of C, matching S-08's footprint), but the actual purlin/rafter framing (thick double lines with the 'จันทันเหล็ก'/'แปเหล็ก' leaders) is only drawn from row B southward to C' (1.00m south of C). Read as: this lower roof plane physically covers only the B-to-C' (porch) zone; the outline/X-marks north of B are a reference/alignment guide to the upper roof's grid, not framing belonging to this sheet. Rafters recorded B-to-C' only.

FOUR purlin rows are drawn, not three — flagged by Makham 2026-08-26. An earlier pass recorded only B, C and C' and folded the fourth into a spacing_mm note. Each purlin is drawn as its channel seen in plan (a pair of lines 45mm apart, the C-75x45's flange); pixel-scanning those outlines (157.4 px/m, calibrated on A-C = 5.40m) puts the four centrelines at 3.72, 4.61, 5.49 and 6.38 — an even ~0.89m pitch, which is what the '@ไม่เกิน 1.00 ม.' note asks for. Rounded to the grid they are B, B' (new dummy at 4.60), C and C'. The small offsets (each purlin sits 0.02-0.12m south of its nominal line) are how the channel is set out against the line, not four separate positions worth their own dummies.

The new row is B', NOT C''. C'' (6.60) is the balcony edge on the floor plans and is south of C' — it has nothing to do with this roof. See the grid master's B' warning for why the line joins B's family rather than C's.
